name: Nefiracetam
summary: Nootropic compound of the racetam family. The drug is reported to enhance both GABAergic and cholinergic signaling. Long-term use is suggested to be neuroprotective. The drug is fat soluble.
advisory: The drug is typically divided into three doses. Roughly 0.5mg-1.6mg/kg.
doseBasis: NOTE: The drug is typically divided into three doses. Roughly 0.5mg-1.6mg/kg.

pharmacology.text: Unlike other racetams, nefiracetam shows high affinity for the GABAA receptor (IC50 = 8.5 nM), where it is presumed to be an agonist. It was able to potently inhibit 80% of muscimol binding to the GABAA receptor, although it failed to displace the remaining 20% of specific muscimol binding.

uses.en: It has been studied as a nootropic and for memory and mood problems after stroke or brain injury. It is not an approved medicine in most countries.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究作為益智藥，以及用於中風或腦傷後的記憶與情緒問題。在大多數國家它並非核准藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究作为益智药，以及用于中风或脑伤后的记忆与情绪问题。在大多数国家它并非核准药物。

fact.en: Nefiracetam was developed in Japan and, unlike other racetams, dissolves readily in fat rather than water, which changes how it moves around the body.
fact.zh: 奈非西坦由日本研發，與其他吡拉西坦類不同，它易溶於脂肪而非水，這改變了它在體內的分布方式。
fact.zhHans: 奈非西坦由日本研发，与其他吡拉西坦类不同，它易溶于脂肪而非水，这改变了它在体内的分布方式。
